I STRAINED MY SIGHT TO DISCOVER WHAT IT COULD BE AND UTTERED A WILD CRY OF ECSTASY WHEN I DISTINGUISHED A SLEDGE AND THE DISTORTED PROPORTIONS OF A WELL-KNOWN FORM WITHIN. OH!
